ideas.title: Investigating government shutdown impact on agencies
ideas.description: This story would investigate the effects of the government shutdown on various agencies, including ICE, travelers, and the Coast Guard.
questions: How has the government shutdown affected ICE operations?
What are the consequences of the shutdown on travelers and the Coast Guard?
ideas.insight: This story is important because it highlights the far-reaching consequences of the government shutdown on various agencies and the people they serve. I will investigate the financial and operational impacts of the shutdown on these agencies.
